1.name: Aquaria

web_tutorials.name: Multiworld Setup Guide
web_tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Aquaria for MultiWorld.

web_tutorials.name: Guide de configuration Multimonde
web_tutorials.description: Un guide pour configurer Aquaria MultiWorld

1.world_description:
Aquaria is a side-scrolling action-adventure game. It follows Naija, an
aquatic humanoid woman, as she explores the underwater world of Aquaria.
Along her journey, she learns about the history of the world she inhabits
as well as her own past. The gameplay focuses on a combination of swimming,
singing, and combat, through which Naija can interact with the world. Her
songs can move items, affect plants and animals, and change her physical
appearance into other forms that have different abilities, like firing
projectiles at hostile creatures, or passing through barriers inaccessible
to her in her natural form.
From: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aquaria_(video_game)

2.name: Civilization VI

web_tutorials.name: Multiworld Setup Guide
web_tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Civilization VI for MultiWorld.

2.world_description: Civilization VI is a turn-based strategy video game in which one or more players compete alongside computer-controlled opponents to grow their individual civilization from a small tribe to control the entire planet across several periods of development.

3.name: Hylics 2

web_tutorials.name: Multiworld Setup Guide
web_tutorials.description: A guide to settings up the Hylics 2 randomizer connected to an Archipelago Multiworld

3.world_description:
Hylics 2 is a surreal and unusual RPG, with a bizarre yet unique visual style. Play as Wayne,
travel the world, and gather your allies to defeat the nefarious Gibby in his Hylemxylem!

4.name: Mario & Luigi Superstar Saga

web_tutorials.name: Setup Guide
web_tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga for Archipelago.

4.world_description:
Adventure with Mario and Luigi together in the Beanbean Kingdom
to stop the evil Cackletta and retrieve the Beanstar.

5.name: Paint

web_tutorials.name: Start Guide
web_tutorials.description: A guide to playing Paint in Archipelago.

5.world_description:
The classic Microsoft app, reimagined as an Archipelago game! Find your tools, expand your canvas, and paint the
greatest image the world has ever seen.

6.name: Subnautica

web_tutorials.name: Multiworld Setup Guide
web_tutorials.description: A guide to setting up the Subnautica randomizer connected to an Archipelago Multiworld

6.world_description:
Subnautica is an undersea exploration game. Stranded on an alien world, you become infected by
an unknown bacteria. The planet's automatic quarantine will shoot you down if you try to leave.
You must find a cure for yourself, build an escape rocket, and leave the planet.
